name: Lemon-Cilantro Chicken Kebab with Blueberry Salsa & Sautéed Veggies

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: If using wooden skewers, place 4-8 skewers in a shallow dish of water to soak until you are ready to use them.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 jalapeño pepper
1 small bunch cilantro
2 (6 oz) pkgs blueberries
1 lemon
4 medium carrots
2 medium zucchini squash

instructions.primary_message: Quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon. Finely dice and place in a small bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the cilantro to the bowl with the jalapeño. (Place remaining cilantro in a medium bowl and set aside.)
Roughly chop blueberries and add to the bowl with the jalapeño and cilantro; add vinegar, oil, honey, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the salsa and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince garlic; zest and juice lemon. Add both to the bowl with the remaining cilantro, along with oil and spices. Stir to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tsp basil, dried
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces, add to the bowl with the marinade, and stir to coat. Thread chicken onto skewers and place on a plate; alternatively, you can cook the chicken pieces directly on the grill pan without using skewers.
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the grill pan is hot, add the kebabs and cook, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through, 8-10 minutes. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, trim, and slice carrots crosswise into thin rounds; peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Place both in another medium bowl.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, trim and halve zucchini lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin half-moons; add to the bowl with the carrot and onion.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until fork-tender, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chicken kebabs, sautéed veggies, and salsa between plates. Enjoy!
